manager.label: Manager review
manager.description: Each person's manager reviews them. This review carries the rating.

peer.label: Peer review
peer.description: Colleagues review the person — chosen after launch, or nominated by the person.

upward.label: Upward review
upward.description: Each person who manages people is reviewed by their direct reports. Always anonymous.

peerMode.subjectNominates: The person nominates, their manager approves

token.subject: First name of the person reviewed
token.subjectFullName: Full name of the person reviewed
token.manager: First name of their manager in the cycle

problem.excluded: Neither the person nor their manager can be chosen.

nomination.nominateIntro: Choose {same, select, yes {{min}} other {{min} to {max}}} colleagues who know your work. Your manager writes their own review, so they cannot be one of them. {hasApprover, select, yes {{approver}} other {Your manager}} approves the list{hasDate, select, yes { by {date}} other {}}; if nobody does by then, it stands as you sent it.
nomination.approveIntro: {name} nominated these colleagues. Remove or add before approving — between {min} and {max}. Each approved peer is asked at once.{hasDate, select, yes { If nobody approves by {date}, the nomination stands as sent.} other {}}
nomination.autoApproved: Nobody approved by the approval date, so the nomination stood as sent. {count, plural, one {# peer was asked.} other {# peers were asked.}}
nomination.peersAsked: {count, plural, one {# peer was asked.} other {# peers were asked.}}
nomination.waitingForManager: Waiting for the manager to approve.

empty.title: Nobody chosen yet
empty.nominate: Pick the colleagues who worked with you closely enough to review you.
empty.approve: Add the colleagues who should review this person.

problem.name: Give the cycle a name.
problem.dueBeforeOpens: A review is due before it opens.
problem.scaleLabel: Every point of the rating scale needs a label.
problem.peerRange: Peers per person: at least one, and the least no more than the most.
problem.threshold: The anonymity threshold runs from {min} to {max}.
problem.approvedBeforeNominated: Peers are approved before they are nominated.
problem.dueBeforeApproved: The peer review is due before its peers are approved.
problem.approvalNeedsManager: An approval of the manager review needs a manager review.

builder.saveToLaunch: Save the draft to launch it.
builder.templateNote: A template is never launched. Add a cycle from it, or let an automation start one for a person.

who.title: Who takes part
who.hint: With no conditions, everybody who works here now takes part. The list is read once, at launch.
who.hiredHint: Somebody hired later has not been here long enough to be reviewed.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.hint: Each review has its own form and its own window. Peers are chosen by you after launch, or nominated by each person.
reviews.noForms: Every review needs a form, and there are none yet. <link>Add one under Forms</link> — blank, or from the library — and come back.

scale.title: Rating scale
scale.hint: Every rating question of this cycle is answered on this scale, from the lowest point to the highest.

results.title: Results
results.hint: The person reviewed reads their self review and their manager's. They never see peer reviews.
results.managerShares: The manager shares — each manager shares a review once theirs is in, when they are ready.
results.releasedOnDate: Released on a date — every review whose manager review is in is shared on one day.
results.approvalHint: A submitted manager review waits for approval before it can be shared or released. The approver may send it back with a comment.
results.approvalHintSkipLevel: A submitted manager review waits for approval before it can be shared or released. The approver may send it back with a comment. A manager with no manager of their own has their reviews approved by the cycle's owner.

deleteDialog.templateBody: {name} is removed. Cycles already started from it stay; an automation that starts reviews from it is paused.
deleteDialog.cycleBody: {name} is removed. It has not been launched, so nobody has been asked for anything.

builder.leaveDescription: The changes to this cycle are only on this page. Leaving now discards them.

kind.upwardHint: Every direct report at launch reviews their manager, without their name. Until this many upward reviews of a manager are in, nobody reads them; the manager reads them in their shared review. Fixed once the cycle is launched.
kind.nominateHint: Each person nominates their peers by the first date; their manager approves, removes or adds by the second. Nominations nobody approves by then stand as sent.
kind.anonymous: Anonymous — nobody sees who wrote a peer review, HR included
kind.peerHint: Until this many peer reviews of a person are in, nobody reads them — the manager sees only how many are waiting. Fixed once the cycle is launched.
kind.peerHintBelow: Until this many peer reviews of a person are in, nobody reads them — the manager sees only how many are waiting. Fixed once the cycle is launched. The most peers per person is below it, so their reviews would never be shown.

repeat.title: Repeat cycle
repeat.description: A new draft with the same people, reviews, forms and settings as {name}, every date moved later.
repeat.noDates: This cycle has no dates to move; the new draft has none either.

heldBack.note: {count, plural, one {# anonymous {kind, select, upward {upward} other {peer}} review is in} other {# anonymous {kind, select, upward {upward} other {peer}} reviews are in}} and held back to keep its writers anonymous — shown once there are {threshold}.

write.anonymous: Your name is not shown with this review, to anybody.
write.missing: {count, plural, one {One required question is not answered} other {# required questions are not answered}}
write.cycleClosed: This cycle is closed; the review can no longer be written.
write.notYours: This review is no longer yours to write.

confirm.amend: {name} has already read this review; they see the new version, marked as updated, and are asked to acknowledge it again.
confirm.manager: Once submitted, the review changes only after it is shared, as an update {name} sees.
confirm.final: Once submitted, the review can no longer be changed.

declineDialog.title: Decline peer review
declineDialog.body: Whoever runs the cycle is told, and may ask somebody else.

empty.title: No reviews
empty.description: Reviews from performance review cycles appear here once there is one you can read.

empty.title: No reviews for you yet
empty.description: When a review cycle asks you to write a review, it appears here and in your Tasks. Reviews shared with you appear here too.

toWrite.title: To write
toWrite.emptyDescription: Nothing to write right now. A new review appears here and in your Tasks.

aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.emptyDescription: Once your review is shared with you, you read it and acknowledge it here.
aboutMe.sharedWaiting: Shared {date} — waiting for you to acknowledge

empty.title: No review cycles yet
empty.description: A cycle asks a group of people to review themselves and each other, and their managers to review them, on dates you set.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Never launched themselves: a cycle is added from one, or an automation starts one for a person.

overview.label: Overview
overview.description: Every review cycle, and who has written what.

me.label: My reviews
me.description: The reviews you are asked to write, the ones shared with you, and your people's.

forms.label: Forms
forms.description: The questionnaires a review cycle asks its reviewers to fill in.

packet.calibrated: Calibrated{hasFrom, select, yes { from {from}} other {}}{hasBy, select, yes { by {by}} other {}}{hasAt, select, yes { on {at}} other {}}{hasReason, select, yes {: {reason}} other {}}
packet.managerNotIn: The manager review is not in yet.
packet.upwardHeading: Upward reviews — from direct reports, anonymous

approveDialog.title: Approve review
approveDialog.released: {hasManager, select, yes {{manager}'s} other {The manager's}} review of {subject} is released with the others on the date.
approveDialog.share: {hasManager, select, yes {{manager}} other {The manager}} can then share the review with {subject}.

sendBackDialog.body: {hasManager, select, yes {{manager}} other {The manager}} reads your comment on the review, which opens again with its answers.

shareDialog.title: Share review
shareDialog.onBehalf: {subject} will read {hasManager, select, yes {{manager}'s} other {the manager's}} review, their self review and the rating, and is told as if the manager had shared it. The journal records that you shared it on the manager's behalf. A shared review cannot be unshared.
shareDialog.own: {subject} will read your review, their self review and the rating. Peer reviews stay with you. A shared review cannot be unshared; you can still update yours.

acknowledgeDialog.title: Acknowledge review
acknowledgeDialog.body: Acknowledging says you have read it — not that you agree. Your manager sees any comment you add.

empty.title: No review forms yet
empty.description: A form is the set of questions a reviewer answers — about themselves, a colleague, a report or their manager.

row.facts: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · Updated {date}

archiveDialog.title: Archive form
archiveDialog.body: {name} can no longer be chosen for a review cycle. You can unarchive it later.

deleteDialog.title: Delete form
deleteDialog.body: {name} and its questions are removed. This cannot be undone.

addForm.notAdded: The library form was not added. Open the library to see why.
addForm.description: Start blank or from one of the library's forms. Either way the editor opens next, and everything in it can be changed.

blank.title: Blank form
blank.summary: No questions yet — write your own.

note.addedBefore: Added here before as {name}, and kept as it has been changed since. Open it — and duplicate it there for a variant — or start blank.
note.taken: “{name}” is taken here too. Rename the company’s own form first, or start blank.
note.addsRenamed: Adds {name} — the library’s name is already taken here.

preview.shownAs: Shown as a reviewer writing about {subject}, managed by {manager}, in {cycle} would see it.
preview.noQuestions: This form has no questions yet.

question.question: Question {number}
question.ratingHint: Answered on the review cycle's rating scale, with room for a comment.
question.overallHint: The manager form's overall rating becomes the person's rating for the cycle.

problem.question: Write the question.
problem.options: Give at least two different options.

gate.name: Give the form a name to save it.
gate.unfinished: {count, plural, one {One question is not finished yet.} other {# questions are not finished yet.}}

editor.archived: This form is archived and cannot be changed or chosen for a review cycle.
editor.archivedManage: This form is archived and cannot be changed or chosen for a review cycle. Unarchive it to edit it.
editor.introductionHint: Shown to the reviewer above the questions. Here and in every question, type @ to name the person reviewed (@subject, @subjectFullName), their manager (@manager) or the cycle (@cycle).

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.readOnly: Nobody has added a question to this form.
empty.description: Add the questions a reviewer answers. Group them under sections, and type @ where a name belongs: @subject for the person reviewed, @manager for their manager, @cycle for the cycle.

editor.archiveBodyDirty: {name} can no longer be chosen for a review cycle. Unsaved changes on this page are discarded. You can unarchive it later.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: The changes to this form are only on this page. Leaving now discards them.

launch.title: Launch cycle
launch.description: Launching asks everybody below for their reviews and puts them in their Tasks. After launch the forms, the kinds of review, the scale and anonymity can no longer change; dates still can.
launch.excludedByHireDate: {count, plural, one {# person was} other {# people were}} hired after the eligibility date and are not included.
launch.noManager: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} no manager and get no manager review
launch.footNominate: Each person gets a task to nominate their peers; their manager approves them. Anonymity and its threshold are fixed at launch.
launch.footAdmin: Peers are chosen after launch, on the cycle’s page. Anonymity and its threshold are fixed at launch.

people.emptyDescription: Everybody who took part has been removed from this cycle.

reviewers.emptyTitle: Nobody has a review to write
reviewers.emptyDescription: A reviewer appears here once the cycle asks them to write — peers once they are chosen.

run.closeBody: Reviews not yet submitted ({count}) are withdrawn and their tasks cancelled. What was written stays, and shared reviews stay readable. A closed cycle cannot be reopened.
run.shareBody: {subject} will read the manager review{hasManager, select, yes { by {manager}} other {}}, their self review and the rating, and is told as if the manager had shared it. The journal records that you shared it on the manager's behalf. A shared review cannot be unshared.
run.removeBody: {name} is no longer reviewed in this cycle. Reviews about them that are not in yet are withdrawn; what was written stays.

person.belowThreshold: Fewer peers than the anonymity threshold of {threshold} — their reviews stay hidden

settings.approvedBy: Manager reviews are approved by {mode, select, PERSON {{hasName, select, yes {{name}} other {a named person}}} SKIP_LEVEL {the manager's manager} other {no approval}} before they are shared.
settings.nominated: nominated by the person{hasNomination, select, yes { by {nomination}} other {}}{hasApproval, select, yes {, approved by {approval}} other {}}
settings.lockedNote: A launched cycle keeps its forms, kinds, scale and anonymity; only the dates change, from Edit Dates.

peers.description: Colleagues who review {name}. They have {count} now; this cycle asks for {min}–{max}. Each is asked at once and gets a task.
peers.full: This person already has the most peers the cycle allows.

handOnDialog.description: The {kind, select, SELF {self review} MANAGER {manager review} PEER {peer review} other {upward review}} of {subject}, now with {reviewer}. Anything already typed goes with it.
handOnDialog.descriptionManager: The {kind, select, SELF {self review} MANAGER {manager review} PEER {peer review} other {upward review}} of {subject}, now with {reviewer}. Anything already typed goes with it. The new reviewer becomes the manager who shares this review.

datesDialog.description: Open reviews take the new due date, and their reminders move with it.

calibration.intro: {cycle} · {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}{hasClosed, select, yes { · closed {closed}} other {}}. A changed rating becomes the person's final rating; the manager review stays as written. Calibrating does not share or approve anything.
calibration.hidden: {count, plural, one {# person in this session is} other {# people in this session are}} outside the results you can read, and not shown.
calibration.closeBody: Ratings and potentials in this session are frozen. The ratings stand as calibrated; a closed session cannot be reopened.

empty.title: Nobody to calibrate here
empty.description: The people of this session are outside the results you may read.

adjust.description: {name}'s final rating. Their manager gave {hasRating, select, yes {{rating}} other {no rating}}; what the manager wrote stays as it is. The change and its reason are recorded.
adjust.reasonHint: Read by the manager, the approver and HR. Never shown to {name}.

sessions.intro: Line up final ratings across managers, each change with a reason, and set each person's potential for the 9-box. Only people whose review is not shared yet can change.
sessions.facts: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {calibrated} calibrated · {date}
sessions.factsBy: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {calibrated} calibrated · added by {name} · {date}
sessions.dialogDescription: With no conditions, everybody in the cycle is in the session. Who is in it is read now, once.

unplaced.title: Unplaced
unplaced.description: People with no potential yet, or no rating to place them by. Set a potential on a card, or drag it into a box of its own performance row.

results.byDepartmentHint: Every review about the people of a department, together.
results.ratingsOnlyReadable: Ratings are shown only for people whose results you can read.
results.ratingsHidden: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} outside the results you can read and left out of the ratings below.
results.distributionHint: Final ratings — calibrated where a session changed them.
results.byManagerHint: What each manager gave, and what their people were finally given.
results.noManagerRatings: No manager has rated anybody in this cycle yet.

export.title: Export results
export.description: The results of {name}: one row a person whose results you can read. No answers are exported.
export.included: Included: person, email, department, manager, status, manager rating, final rating and its label, potential, calibrated, shared on, acknowledged on.

blocker.noKinds: Choose at least one kind of review.
blocker.nominationDatesMissing: Peers nominated by the person reviewed need a nomination date and an approval date.
blocker.approvalNeedsManagerReview: An approval of the manager review needs a manager review.
blocker.approverMissing: Choose who approves the manager reviews.
blocker.releaseDateMissing: Choose the date the results are released.

warning.peerMaxBelowAnonymity: At most {peerMax, plural, one {# peer reviews} other {# peers review}} one person, fewer than the anonymity threshold of {threshold}: nobody will read their anonymous peer reviews.
warning.fewReportsForUpward: {count, plural, one {# person manages} other {# people manage}} fewer direct reports than the upward anonymity threshold of {threshold}: their upward reviews will be held back.

peer.reviewerCapExceeded: {name} now writes {count, plural, one {# peer review} other {# peer reviews}} in this cycle.

locked.removed: Read-only: they were taken out of the cycle.
locked.shared: Read-only: their review was already shared, and its rating changes only by the manager’s amendment.
